business_summary: Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells chemical industrial products in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, the Middle East, and internationally. The company offers barium and strontium salt products; and zinc oxide for rubber, paints, plastics, electronic materials, cosmetics, and heat-dissipation materials. It also provides plastic additives, such as metallic soaps, hydrotalcite, and flame retardants, as well as calcium/zinc-based composite stabilizers; catalysts comprising De-NOx/De-DXN catalysts, hydrogenation catalysts, titanium catalysts for polyester polymerization, titanium dioxide for catalyst carriers, and catalysts for raw materials of synthetic fibers; and electronic materials, which includes dielectric materials, spherical silica, and secondary batteries and electrode materials. In addition, the company offers cosmetic raw materials, such as titanium dioxide, flake-shaped barium sulfate, spherical calcium carbonate, spherical barium sulfate, and cosmetic inorganic fluorescent materials. Further, it provides organic chemical products containing sulfur and phosphorus structures for the electronics, resin materials, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, lubricant materials, and water treatment materials sectors; pharmaceuticals comprising prescription and OTC drugs, health food, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and pharmaceutical intermediates; and road marking materials for compartment lines, road markings, expressways, and braille sheets. The company exports its products. Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본, 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 중동 및 국제적으로 화학 공업 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 바륨 및 스트론튬 염 제품을 제공합니다. 고무, 도료, 플라스틱, 전자재료, 화장품, 방열재료 등에 사용되는 산화아연 등이 있습니다. 또한 금속비누, 하이드로탈사이트, 난연제 등의 플라스틱 첨가제와 칼슘/아연계 복합안정제 등을 제공합니다. De-NOx/De-DXN 촉매, 수소화 촉매, 폴리에스테르 중합용 티타늄 촉매, 촉매 담체용 이산화티타늄, 합성섬유 원료용 촉매로 이루어진 촉매; 유전체 재료, 구형 실리카, 2차 전지 및 전극 재료 등을 포함한 전자재료 등이 있습니다. 이 밖에도 이산화티타늄, 플레이크형 황산바륨, 구형 탄산칼슘, 구형 황산바륨, 화장품 무기형광체 등의 화장품 원료도 제공하고 있다. 또한, 전자, 수지재료, 제약용 황 및 인 구조를 함유한 유기화학 제품을 제공합니다.
